Add your report

Choose a clear, upright photo of the written report. English printed text is supported. Actual scan pictures, PDFs, HEIC and handwriting are not supported.

Start with your report

Your documented findings and possible care pathways will appear here. Try an example to see how it works.

Understand the limits. This is a rule-based research demonstration, not a validated AI medical service. It recognizes four example finding groups: kidney stones, fatty liver, wrist/arm fractures, and explicitly reported anemia. It does not diagnose, prescribe, assess emergencies, or interpret scan images. Unmatched text needs clinical review; an empty result does not mean a normal report.
Built for understanding. For review with your doctor.No account, server-side report storage, or external AI calls.
